scope: Fixed official baseline and migration performance-preservation comparison; dirty snapshots are labeled and no formal paper cohort is claimed

record.kind: frozen source and artifact observation after linking; library was incrementally compiled from these matching source files

source_core_files.aggregate_encoding: SHA256 of sorted SHA256 + two spaces + repository-relative path + newline

candidate_core_files.aggregate_encoding: SHA256 of sorted SHA256 + two spaces + repository-relative path + newline

record.limitation: The release archive was built before the final commit was created; explicit source-file and artifact hashes connect that build to the frozen commit. This record does not infer source identity merely from HEAD.

units: Nanoseconds per shot; repetition distributions are batch means, not shot latency percentiles
comparison: Primary speedup = median(fixed official batch means) / median(candidate batch means); additional migration comparison = median(source batch means) / median(candidate batch means); values below one expose a slowdown against the named baseline
